title: bird error envelope
description: Universal error-response shape emitted on stderr when bird exits non-zero under --output json. Matches the anc (agent-native-cli) envelope contract.

error.description: Stable kebab-case machine identifier. An X API error carries the reason xdk-rs classifies it with, the same one `xr` reports (e.g. "auth-required", "rate-limited", "network-error"); bird's own errors carry ids such as "config-error", "unknown-schema", "invalid-value".

message.description: Human-readable error message. Control characters sanitized to '?' to prevent terminal escape injection from upstream API bodies.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. 2 (usage), 77 (auth), 78 (config). A general error exits 3 when rate limited (HTTP 429), 4 when not found (HTTP 404), 5 when the request got no HTTP response (network or filesystem failure), 130 or 143 when SIGINT or SIGTERM cancelled an in-flight X API call (error `cancelled`), and 1 otherwise.

meta.description: Always-present metadata object (possibly empty) for parity with the success envelope.

command.description: Subcommand name that triggered the error, when known.

status.description: Upstream HTTP status code, when the error originated from an API response.
